description.en: Yamato, time to take off again.

description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』に登場のヤマト2202版が1/1000スケールで、いよいよ登場！
description.en: The Yamato 2202 version that appeared in "Space Battleship Yamato 2202" is finally available in 1/1000 Scale!

description.ja: • 精密なディテールでヤマト2202を再現！
• 新規パーツで第4艦橋の展開と、安定翼の展開・収納を再現。
description.en: • New parts reproduce the deployment of the 4th bridge and the deployment and storage of the stabilizing wings.

description.ja: • 2202版に合わせた「LEDユニット(青)」が付属し、波動砲と艦橋部の発光が再現可能。
description.en: • An "LED unit (blue)" that matches the 2202 version is included, allowing you to reproduce the light emission of the wave motion gun and the bridge.

description.ja: • 別売りの「発光ユニット(白)2灯式」と付属のオレンジのクリアパーツを使用すれば、エンジンの発光も再現可能。
description.en: • If you use the separately sold "Light-emitting unit (white) 2-lamp type" and the included orange clear parts, you can also reproduce the engine's light emission.

description.ja: • メカコレクション ゆうなぎが付属。

accessories.ja: メカコレコレクションゆうなぎ×1

contents.ja: マーキングシール（ゆうなぎ）×1
